integrity: The new finite maxima are obtained by complete enumeration of every unordered binary center pair at \(4\le n\le9\), with eligibility checked in two equivalent ways. The infinite tail is not extrapolated from the finite data; it is taken from the cited theorem and construction. The verifier regenerates all finite deletion balls from scratch.
scientific limitations: Binary alphabet and the single diagonal parameter \(\ell=t=3\) only. The values for \(4\le n\le9\) are finite exhaustive results; the statement for \(n\ge10\) is prior published work. No claim is made for larger alphabets, off-diagonal parameters, or intersections of three or more centers.
title: Exact preasymptotic profile for \(N(n,3,3)\) in binary deletion reconstruction
